annotator.quality_note: Frontier-hosted annotator via the CMU ai-gateway on the validated-outcome sample (16 unsafe trajectories whose graders start safe, plus a matched validated-safe sample). The earlier 70-trajectory study is contaminated. Still a candidate label set, not ground truth.
